scope: Three-repeat 12K pressure native/static/single-request comparison. Preliminary; native repeat1 has severe sampling gaps. Group2 and full-model profiles incomplete.

summary.note: Small repeat counts limit inference. Request percentiles pool measured requests. The NVML sum peak uses one shared sample, while per-rank peaks may occur at different times.

artifact_audit.scope: Checks result artifact consistency. Model, image, source provenance and external GPU runtime/resource evidence are not verified. Token hashes validate recorded output IDs only and do not establish KV byte correctness. VMM cleanup is checked at the benchmark idle checkpoint. Later per-rank files can include pending reclamation after semantic probes. NVML gaps include both active-window edges. They describe sampling coverage only, without rejecting artifacts or establishing GPU exclusivity or idle time.

capacity.derivation: Audited MiniMax pool and allocator code; logical/index capacity is physical pool size times ratio.

notes: GPU process sampling is not a device reservation or continuous exclusivity proof.
Frozen NVML reads are serial, with one sweep-end timestamp; sum is not simultaneous.
Keep every repeat including native repeat1; missing observations and slow requests are not a causal diagnosis.
Adaptive and VMM counters include startup probes, correctness and warmup; they cannot identify per-measured-phase migration overhead.
Physical releases are cumulative and can exceed live backing; they are not peak whole-card savings.
Semantic probes and token hashes are not a KV byte oracle. Prior independent shadow correctness remains bounded evidence.
